images.name: hero-house
images.prompt: Wide view of a long single-storey Banat farmhouse (salas) with ornate brick gable and sage shutters, standing alone in golden wheat fields at golden hour, tall acacia tree beside it. Editorial architectural photography for a boutique farmstay hotel in the Banat plains of Vojvodina. Shot on medium format film, Kodak Portra 400 palette: warm ochre brick, whitewashed lime walls, faded sage green shutters, linen, oak, terracotta roof tiles. Soft low sun, gentle haze, natural imperfections, no people facing camera, no text, no logos.
